description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'linear_svc' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + calibrated Linear SVM.
model: linear_svc (TF-IDF word featurizer + calibrated Linear SVM)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'linear_svc', group(s): linear); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
